assessment: The findings of this work are important and offer significant advances to current knowledge. This manuscript used state of the art techniques and employed relevant animal models to provide convincing evidence supporting the regulatory role of microRNA cluster 221/222 in rheumatoid arthritis synovial fibroblast. Targeting miR-221/222 in SFs of patients harboring inflammatory arthritis might have a therapeutic benefit, and will be interesting to a wide range audience in the rheumatology and bone research fields.
